about_the_game:
Ballrun is a multiplayer marble racing game where you use wild powers and twist your luck to win. Roll through exciting tracks filled with shortcuts and surprise skills to pick up. With snappy physics and unpredictable players, no two races ever play out the same.

Demo content:

Marble races 

In races, you and many other marbles rush down twisty tracks. One goal: crossing the finish line first. With responsive physics and elaborate maps, every bump, collision, and unexpected turn can change the outcome of a race. Stay sharp and adapt to whatever the road throws at you! The demo offers a racing experience that’s very close to what you’ll find in the final game.

Skills

In Ballrun, you use powers to affect the outcome of a race. A shockwave to send others flying or a jump to clear tricky gaps… When you pick up a power on the road, you never know what’s coming! You can carry multiple powers at once and hold onto them as long as you want. Creating combinations and timing your moves right can help you take shortcuts and outpace the competition. In this demo, you’ll get to try out five of the skills that will be available in the final game.

Tracks

Race through tracks packed with playful obstacles, clever shortcuts, and alternate routes. Whether you're weaving through tight corners or launching off ramps, each track gives you new ways to outsmart the competition. The demo includes four of these maps: two set in the jungle, one on the beach, and one in the city, offering a taste of the variety you’ll find in the full game.

Multiplayer and solo

There are a bunch of settings that let you customize the experience in this demo. Want to roll with random people, with your Twitch community, or just your friends? You’ve got options! Join a game or set up your own, public or private, solo or with bots, with teams or free-for-all.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core I3 (7th Gen) / AMD Ryzen 3 (3rd Gen)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core I5 (8th Gen) / AMD Ryzen 5 (5th Gen)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2050
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Be a marble in this multiplayer racing game with snappy and satisfying physics! Use wild powers to bounce and roll your way through fun tracks filled with obstacles, shortcuts, and unpredictable rivals. This demo offers a taste of the variety you’ll find in the full game.
